title: StockSmart Questions on Storeroom Cover for Converted Bins on Frequently Serviced Programs
content:
**Rule.** For the customer-owned fill-to level of a StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program bin converted from consignment at a par review, the storeroom cover follows the program's service: a program whose tier schedules 20 or more visits a month and that completed 18 or more scheduled or onsite daily visits in the latest month takes 0.5 week; a program whose tier schedules 8 to 19 visits a month and that completed 6 or more such visits in the latest month takes 1 week. Any other program's storeroom cover is not shortened under this rule.

**Q. Which visits count?** Completed visits of the scheduled kind and of the onsite daily kind, in the latest month. Emergency visits do not count toward these figures.

**Q. What is the latest month?** Rows of age zero, a row's age in whole months being the number of calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the row's day of the month.

**Q. Both parts must hold?** Yes. The tier's scheduled visits a month and the visits actually completed in the latest month must both reach the figures of the same line.

**Q. Hypothetically, a tier scheduling 22 visits a month completes 18 in the latest month.** 0.5 week. With 17 completed, the cover is not shortened.

**Q. A tier scheduling 8 visits a month completes 6.** 1 week. With 5, not shortened.

**Q. A tier scheduling 4 visits a month completes all 4.** Not shortened; the tier schedules fewer than 8.
